subject: Existing translator mechanisms for format variants and exact Threads
body: Pinned metal2vulkan already has required mechanisms: src/bind/state.rs1056 StageTable has textures/samplers/threadgroup_lengths;1133 BoundTexture has distinct Texture vs Buffer forms;1157 TextureFacts includes view parent level/size, sparse,depth_twin,swizzle,address map,own_format_views. Avoid inventing a truncated facts model. src/cache/tests.rs1941-2010 demonstrates storage-format stand-in -> planned VariantKey -> compile_function(key.lowering_inputs(Stage::Kernel)) -> compile_compute_pipeline. Current C Pipeline must retain function descriptor/library to compile later variants. src/bind/dispatch.rs89-99 Dispatch::Threads splits nonuniform edges into exact regions with per-region local sizes/base pushes; current native_dispatch rejects regions!=1, so v2 should carry multiple regions rather than round grid. Bounds already MAX_REGIONS4096; choose an explicit transport bound and return precise errors if exceeded.
